reason: My udhaar diary has worked for years and I trust it more than any phone. I am not giving my customers' udhaar details to an app or an AI, even if it is free for three months.
objection: I don't trust an app or AI with my customers' udhaar details. If it gets a name or an amount wrong, I lose money and I lose the customer's respect.
would_change_my_mind: If a shop owner I know and trust, who has used it for a year, showed me it never got his udhaar wrong. I would also want to keep my paper diary running alongside it.
